# Vendored symbol fonts

`mana.woff2` and `keyrune.woff2` are cut-down copies (made by `tools/vendor-fonts.js`) of:

- **Mana** 1.18.0 by Andrew Gioia, https://mana.andrewgioia.com and
  https://github.com/andrewgioia/mana. The font is licensed under the SIL Open Font
  License 1.1 (https://openfontlicense.org); Mana's CSS is MIT licensed.
- **Keyrune** 3.19.0 by Andrew Gioia, https://keyrune.andrewgioia.com and
  https://github.com/andrewgioia/keyrune. The font files are licensed under the SIL Open Font
  License 1.1. Only the font is used here (its CSS is GPL 3.0); `symbols.css` is this
  project's own.

The fonts keep their embedded copyright and license notices. The symbols they draw are
trademarks of Wizards of the Coast; this project isn't endorsed by Wizards of the Coast.
